items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE architectural design review board for CodeYears city units, not a runtime sprite atlas. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its refined plausible premium city-game architecture, tactile brick/stone/metal/glass, integrated dark roofs, compact soft contact shadows and consistent upper-left daylight. Create original designs, no copied game assets or logos. Same fixed orthographic 2:1 dimetric camera in EVERY cell: ground axis slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical walls perfectly vertical, no perspective convergence. See roof and both front/right facades. Pale warm off-white presentation background, generously spaced cells, crisp beautiful architecture with strong silhouettes, no roads connecting studies, no thick plinths, no white generic roof caps, no watermark. Each cell contains one complete unit. Draw a very faint thin-line ground grid under each unit showing its W by D occupied daily cells; W goes screen right/down, D goes screen left/down. Keep grid cell size consistent across the board; height H is relative structural height, never independently normalize each building to the same size. A/B alternatives must differ in massing and materials, not just tint. Small clear exact ASCII labels below cells only. These are concept studies; they are not production-calibrated assets. Portrait board, TWO columns A/B and FOUR rows H1/H2/H3/H4, EIGHT buildings total. All footprints 1x1, same ground diamond size. Structural roof heights must increase by logical 1:2:3:4 across the rows, making the height progression obvious, roughly 3,6,9,12 floors. Row 1 labels "1x1 H1 A" and "1x1 H1 B": warm red-brick Brooklyn townhouse with dark integrated parapet roof, versus cream-gray stone small mixed-use building with green storefront and coherent dark roof. Row 2 "1x1 H2 A/B": terracotta corner apartment with stepped cornice, versus cool limestone apartment with recessed balconies. Row 3 "1x1 H3 A/B": copper-brown stepped mid-high office versus smoky blue-gray glass office with articulated facade and lower setback. Row 4 "1x1 H4 A/B": slender blue-glass straight tower with charcoal crown versus elegant teal-glass stepped tower with bronze fins. Do not enlarge lower buildings to fill unused space. Full silhouette visible, no cropping.
